## Why This Is Asked
Assesses practical handling of schema drift, governance, and retroactive fixes in a real Databricks pipeline.

## Key Concepts
- Dynamic schema registry with versioned Delta table
- Schema evolution with defaulting for new fields
- Retroactive updates using MERGE for late-arriving drift
- Unity Catalog RBAC across Bronze/Silver/registry

# Pseudocode: load with dynamic schema and map to Silver
from pyspark.sql.functions import from_json, col
schema = load_schema_from_registry(version)
df = spark.read.format("json").option("multiline","true").load("s3://bucket/bronze/")
df2 = df.withColumn("payload", from_json(col("raw"), schema))
silver = df2.select("payload.*")  # map fields to Silver
```

## Why This Is Asked

```
